import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    base = -(p[0] + p[1]/t + p[2]*np.exp(-2*t) + p[3]*t + p[4]*t**2)
    amp = p[5] + p[6]*t
    K = p[7]*np.exp(p[8]*t)
    n = p[9]
    An = np.abs(A)**n
    return base + amp*An/(np.abs(K)**n + An)
